# Theme import fixtures

Real theme files, unmodified, for the importer tests (`src/terminal/import.rs`). All are MIT-licensed.

| File | Format | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `dracula.itermcolors` | iTerm2 | <https://github.com/dracula/iterm> `Dracula.itermcolors`, commit `e5749bcd07764ad6e154038892b118ea45f88cc0` |
| `dracula-windows-terminal.json` | Windows Terminal | <https://github.com/dracula/windows-terminal> `dracula.json`, commit `06f63714a0477a7b5c12cf0aa94ecf92d78f32ca` |
| `dracula-kitty.conf` | Kitty | <https://github.com/dracula/kitty> `dracula.conf`, commit `87717a3f00e3dff0fc10c93f5ff535ea4092de70` |
| `dracula-base16.yaml`, `catppuccin-mocha-base16.yaml` | base16 | <https://github.com/tinted-theming/schemes> `base16/`, commit `50f6e3b93a8f62db9d839f8b79a709c1bbdaac53` |

The Alacritty importer is tested on the bundled themes in `assets/themes/upstream/`.
